name: matrix_multiplication
definition: Multiply matrices by summing row-column dot products, valid only when inner dimensions agree.

name: inverse_matrix
definition: The matrix A^{-1} satisfying A A^{-1} = I.

name: eigenvalues
definition: Scalars lambda solving det(A - lambda I) = 0.

name: linear_system
definition: Solve Ax = b for unknown vector x.

name: determinant
definition: Signed scaling factor of a linear map.
